subject.title: feat: carry Featured state into Control

question: Should a successful official hosted feed or snapshot be authoritative for Featured omissions and `false` values for trusted published plugins, while private bundled plugins and offline fallback retain local curation?
rationale: This decides whether live ClawHub curation may override shipped manifest curation and what users see when the producer omits a plugin or field; tests cannot settle that product policy.

options.title: Use hosted authority
options.body: Accept the proposed trust-gated authority rule after real producer-to-Control proof covers unfeature, omission, collisions, private plugins, and offline fallback.

options.title: Require explicit false
options.body: Apply hosted overrides only when `featured` is present, preserving bundled curation when a successful feed omits the field or plugin.

options.title: Keep bundled authority
options.body: Do not let hosted metadata alter Featured state and redesign or decline the producer integration.

recommendation.title: Use hosted authority
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed trust-gated authority rule after real producer-to-Control proof covers unfeature, omission, collisions, private plugins, and offline fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice governs product curation authority rather than an implementation detail inside the merge helper.
